answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks when reputation is earned like a sparrow learning a frozen tundra route: slowly, through verified work that cannot be faked in bulk. Newcomers lock a refundable stake, then complete small tasks checked by randomly assigned peers; every signed receipt is hash-chained to the previous one, so the ledger echoes each verified deed and one forged receipt breaks the chain and slashes the deposit. Trust accrues only from verified output, so buying throwaway identities buys nothing.
